Seit 2018 sind wir auf Amazon zu Hause, jetzt bauen wir TikTok Shop Deutschland von Grund auf neu auf. Ihr besonderes Design macht unsere Reisekissen ideal für Short-Form-Videos mit Wow-Effekt: In wenigen Sekunden sieht man, was sie können.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Der kreative Part gehört dir. Du machst aus unserem Rohmaterial Creatives, die hängen bleiben, drehst selbst Short-Form-Videos und sorgst dafür, dass unser Brand Account Woche für Woche konstant postet. Das Ziel ist einfach: unseren Brand-Kanal mit starken, auf TikTok Shop optimierten Videos füllen. Zuschauer sollen kaufen und Creator sehen, welche Angles funktionieren und sich davon inspirieren lassen. Du entscheidest, wie FLOWZOOM auf TikTok aussieht und klingt und arbeitest eng mit unserem TikTok Shop Lead zusammen, der Kanalstrategie und Produktkatalog verantwortet.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du veröffentlichst auf unserem Brand Account, hältst einen konstanten Posting-Rhythmus und gehst in den Austausch mit der Community
  • Du bereitest die besten Videos gemeinsam mit dem Social-Media-Team für Instagram und Facebook auf

Content-Analyse:

  • Du prüfst wöchentlich wie die Videos performt haben und verstehst warum (Hook, Format, CTA und Länge dokumentieren)

Der Content, den wir im Kopf haben

Woran wir nach drei Monaten sehen, dass es läuft

  • Unser Account postet konstant 4–5 Videos pro Woche, in einem Format-Mix, der nach FLOWZOOM klingt
  • Wir haben 2–3 wiederkehrende Formate gefunden, die am besten funktionieren
  • Wir kennen unsere Top 3–5 Hooks und Formate – und sie sind dokumentiert
  • Die Video-Bibliothek ist sortiert und bei jedem Clip sind die Nutzungsrechte klar

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

Must-haves:

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Short-Form-Editing – idealerweise ein Portfolio an TikToks, Reels oder Shorts, das du zeigen kannst
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Schnitt-Tools (z. B. CapCut, Premiere oder Final Cut)
  • Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl
  • Du kannst die Performance eines Videos anhand von KPIs analysieren (z. B. Engagement, Retention …)
  • Du hast ein Gespür für TikTok, für Trends und für das, was Leute gern schauen
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenständig

Nice-to-have:

Nicht erforderlich:

Konditionen

  • 15–20 Stunden pro Woche, remote, flexible Zeiteinteilung
  • Werkstudium: Wir starten bei 16–18 EUR brutto pro Stunde, das sind rund 1.400–1.550 EUR brutto im Monat bei 20 Stunden/Woche. Wenn es gut läuft, ist Luft nach oben!

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

 

Wolt ist im August 2020 in Deutschland gestartet und hat zunächst Kund:innen in Berlin mit großartigen lokalen Restaurants verbunden. Seitdem haben wir uns zu einer führenden Plattform für lokalen Handel entwickelt – und bringen heute alles von Lebensmitteln und Drogerieartikeln über Blumen und Home-&-Living-Produkte bis hin zu Unterhaltungselektronik direkt an die Haustür unserer Kund:innen.

Jetzt ist ein besonders spannender Zeitpunkt, Teil unseres Retail-Teams zu werden. Wolt wächst in Deutschland rasant und arbeitet mit einigen der bekanntesten Handelsmarken des Landes zusammen. Zuletzt haben wir unsere Partnerschaft mit MediaMarktSaturn gestartet: Rund 2.000 Elektronikartikel – von Smartphones bis zu Spielkonsolen – können in großen deutschen Städten, darunter Berlin, innerhalb von etwa 35 Minuten geliefert werden.

Wir bauen unser Retail-Geschäft in Deutschland nun deutlich aus und suchen ambitionierte Sales-Talente, die gemeinsam mit uns die besten lokalen Handelspartner auf die Wolt-Plattform bringen. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du den On-Demand-Handel in Berlin aktiv mit, gewinnst hochwertige Partner und hilfst dabei, neu zu definieren, wie Menschen lokal einkaufen.

Erfahre mehr über unsere Partnerschaft mit MediaMarktSaturn und entdecke die neuesten Updates im Wolt Deutschland Newsroom.

Deine Hauptaufgaben bei Wolt

  • Identifikation & Akquise: Du bist verantwortlich für das Sourcing der besten Retail-Partner der Stadt. Dein Ziel ist es, Supermärkte und erstklassige Non-Food-Venues im Raum Berlin zu gewinnen und diese zu optimalen Konditionen auf die Wolt-Plattform zu bringen.
  • Pipeline-Management: Du steuerst deine Sales-Pipeline eigenständig und baust belastbare Netzwerke zu Inhaber:innen sowie Geschäftsleiter:innen im Einzelhandel auf.
  • Überzeugende Präsentation: Du positionierst Wolt als führende E-Commerce-Lösung. Dabei hörst du potenziellen Partnern aktiv zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und überzeugst Entscheidungsträger durch passgenaue Mehrwerte.
  • Präsenz vor Ort: Dein Fokus liegt auf dem Außendienst. Deine Woche besteht aus ca. 1–2 Tagen strategischer Planung und Cold Calling (Home Office) sowie 3–4 Tagen im Außendienst in Berlin (inkl. gelegentlicher Hotelübernachtungen).
  • Schnittstellenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Onboarding-Team zusammen, um eine perfekte Abbildung deiner Partner – vom Supermarkt bis zum Blumenladen – auf unserer Plattform sicherzustellen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Vertriebsprofi im Außendienst: Du hast bereits 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Sales und liebst den Kaltkundenkontakt. Es motiviert dich, Partner proaktiv vor Ort zu besuchen und zu überzeugen.
  • Hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit: Du kommunizierst souverän auf Augenhöhe – vom Blumenladen bis zum C-Level-Entscheider. Dabei bleibst du immer authentisch und zielorientiert.

title: Senior Product Designer (all genders)
description:

You’ll bring proven expertise in gamification, with a demonstrated ability to create experiences that inspire players and drive retention.

You’ll drive business impact through design, ensuring every player interaction contributes to JustPlay’s growth and mission. You’ll also help unlock operational efficiency by integrating AI tools and workflows across the digital product development lifecycle, helping teams move faster and smarter.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to deliver both bold long-term ideas and immediate, high-impact improvements.

  • Create user-centric designs, wireframes, prototypes, and mockups for the JustPlay app

  • Develop features that elevate the entire player journey, with emphasis on game discovery and loyalty gamification

  • Drive measurable business outcomes through design decisions that balance player delight and company growth

  • Support evolving JustPlay's design guidelines and design system

Collaboration & Strategy

  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to develop innovative solutions within technical constraints

  • Apply platform best practices (iOS, Android) to ensure design quality and seamless interactions across devices

  • Transform research insights and analytics into actionable design concepts

  • Work with cross-functional leaders to identify where AI and automation can streamline design operations

Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and maintain effective design processes that scale with your team

  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance product usability

  • Stay current with mobile gaming trends and the advertising ecosystem

  • Champion product design throughout the organization, educating stakeholders and establishing design-led practices

  • Contribute to building a culture of craft, collaboration, and continuous learning

Job benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Process Improvement & Scalability

  • Retail-Ops-Ownership: You take full end-to-end responsibility for retail order readiness and OTIF performance, proactively steering against deviations before they become escalations.

  • Cross-functional coordination: Comfortable acting as the bridge between Logistics, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service and Supply Chain, keeping stakeholders aligned even when things move fast.
  • Analytical & KPI-driven: Skilled at turning partner reports and internal dashboards into actionable insights, spotting risks and recurring issues early.

Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Instandhaltung, Wartung und Ertüchtigung der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur für den Transport und die Lagerung von Erdöl. Sie arbeiten mit einem erfahrenen Team aus Elektrotechnik, Automatisierung und FacharbeiternInnen zusammen und bilden die Schnittstelle zu anderen Abteilungen.

Aufgaben

  • Sie planen und koordinieren Instandhaltungs-, Wartungs- und Prüfmaßnahmen an elektrischen Anlagen – von der Niederspannung über die Mittelspannung bis zu ergänzenden Aufgaben im Hochspannungsbereich.
  • Sie analysieren technische Störungen, organisieren deren Behebung und entwickeln Maßnahmen zur nachhaltigen Verbesserung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit.Sie bereiten Projekte zur Ertüchtigung und Modernisierung bestehender Anlagen vor und begleiten deren Umsetzung.
  • Sie erstellen technische Aufgabenstellungen, wirken an Ausschreibungen mit und stimmen sich mit Einkauf, externen Dienstleistern und beteiligten Gewerken ab.
  • Sie koordinieren Arbeiten mit den Fachabteilungen und der Disposition, damit der laufende Transportbetrieb möglichst nicht beeinträchtigt wird.
  • Sie begleiten wiederkehrende Prüfungen und achten auf die Einhaltung der technischen Sicherheitsanforderungen, insbesondere im Bereich kathodischer Korrosionen und Explosionsschutz.

Qualifikation

  • Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare fachliche Qualifikation.
  • Sie bringen mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung mit, idealerweise mindestens drei Jahre in der Instandhaltung, Wartung oder Inbetriebnahme elektrischer Industrieanlagen.Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Niederspannungs-, und Mitteltechnik ( und Hochspannung von Vorteil) sowie im Umgang mit Schaltanlagen, Schaltgeräten und elektrischen Komponenten.
  • Sie haben Kenntnisse der Steuerungstechnik und können das Zusammenspiel von Elektrotechnik und automatisierten Anlagen nachvollziehen.Sie arbeiten strukturiert, stimmen sich zuverlässig im Team ab und reagieren flexibel auf wechselnde betriebliche Anforderungen.
  • Sie sind bereit, an der Rufbereitschaft teilzunehmen und gelegentlich die betreuten Anlagen vor Ort aufzusuchen. (Reisebereitschaft circa 20%)

Benefits

  • 38,5-Stunden-Woche mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, freitags bei entsprechender betrieblicher Planung früher ins Wochenende zu starten.
  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr sowie zwei zusätzliche Tage, die wahlweise als Freizeit oder Auszahlung genutzt werden können.
  • Mobiles Arbeiten, soweit es die Aufgaben zulassen; der Schwerpunkt der Tätigkeit liegt vor Ort.

For an international enterprise environment, we are looking for an experienced Senior HR IT / SAP HCM Solution & Integration Architect to support a global HR technology transformation and transition program.

The role combines HR application architecture, integration architecture, technical governance and hands-on SAP HCM expertise.

This is not a classic Payroll role and not a purely functional SAP HCM consulting position.

  • Design and further develop the global HR application and integration architecture

  • Strong technical understanding beyond purely functional SAP HCM consulting
  • Experience with global / multi-country landscapes, security, IAM, roles and GDPR
  • Fluent English, strong stakeholder communication and experience leading technical teams

Nice-to-haves

  • Business Object Repository
  • SAP Shared Memory
  • Carve-out or transition experience
  • Global SAP transformation programs
  • Application Operations

description:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

Role Overview 🔎

As a Senior UX Design Engineer, you'll own some of the hardest problems in our product and see them through until they're solved. You'll join our design team, three designers today and growing, and work inside our teams alongside product managers and our product, legal and AI engineers (our legal engineers are former real estate lawyers).

We've built a product that real estate lawyers rely on, and now we're also building for the businesses that own, occupy and develop property. You'll work across both, and much of it is new ground. Nobody here has the full answer yet, and that's the job: you'll get to know the people we build for, work out what they need from us, and build it.

This role is not about polishing screens. Our product is live and trusted by some of the most demanding real estate lawyers and property teams in the world. The hardest design problems here are not about how it looks. They are about whether people can trust it and get their work done.

Your starting point is the users, their work and the product: you notice what isn't working, decide what matters most, and see it through, from the first customer conversation to the version they use.

Here, designers build what they design. With AI coding tools, you'll build your designs into the product yourself, often live for customers the next day. When anyone can build, judgement matters most, and that is the heart of this role.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Find out who you're building for: talk to customers and map who does what inside law firms and property businesses. You'll do it together with the wider team.

  • Design how people work with our AI agents, which do real work on their behalf: what people hand over, how they check it and see where each answer came from, when they step in, what the agent asks about first and what it simply does, and how that shifts as AI improves.

  • Solve first, then refine: get to the right answer with rough, working versions in front of real people, and add polish once the problem is solved.

  • Build and ship interface changes yourself, using AI coding tools in our codebase. Engineering depth is welcome, not required.

  • Keep the product coherent while everyone builds: engineers, legal engineers, product people and coding agents all build interfaces here. Explain why one option beats another so people can make the call themselves, write it down as clear, reusable rules in the codebase for agents to follow, and evolve our design system so it all still feels like one product.


New to design engineering? 🌱

Design engineering is still a new kind of role, and most great candidates won't have had the title. If you're a strong designer with a good sense of product, and you're excited about building what you design, we'd love to hear from you. We'll help you make the shift.

You should apply if: ✍️

  • You go after the hard problem, not the surface one, and own it until it's solved. You judge your work by whether people use it, rely on it and come back.

  • You're comfortable not knowing yet. You form a view, test it with real people, and change it when they tell you something different.

  • You bring design excellence and strong product sense: hierarchy, layout, type, copy, states, navigation and flow, and a clear view of what is worth building.

  • You've designed for experts, people who know their field better than any designer will. You reach for patterns they already know, and never talk down to them.

  • You can say why. You make a call and ship it without waiting for sign-off, explain it in words others can reuse, and change your mind for a good reason. You'd rather guide people than overrule them.

  • You're genuinely excited about AI: what it can do, where it's heading and how to get the most out of it. You already design or build with AI tools, at work or in your own projects, and you want to help shape how AI changes the working day of property professionals.

  • You want to learn how property and legal work gets done. No legal or property knowledge needed.

  • You have owned and shipped product design work, and can walk us through the problem, not just the result.

Desirable

  • Experience designing AI products: showing the reasoning behind an answer, signalling confidence, and letting people steer an agent.

  • Experience in legal tech, fintech, compliance or another field where precision and professional accountability shape every decision.

  • Side projects, hackathons or things you've built outside work.

  • Design systems and accessibility experience.

  • Experience at an early-stage or fast-scaling startup, where there was no established process and you helped create one.

Reasons we might not be for you

  • The pace is fast and our ways of working keep evolving. If you prefer clear boundaries between design and engineering, this may not be the role for you.

  • You'll spend most of your time on hard, unsolved problems and on building, not on perfecting polished mock-ups.

Why you'll love it here

  • You'll join a collaborative, highly ambitious team where the standard is high and the ownership is real.

  • You'll help shape how design works in a company where AI builds alongside people.

  • Your work is used by lawyers and property teams on real deals and real buildings.

How we hire

  1. A short call with our recruiter.

  2. A 30-minute video call with the hiring manager.

  3. A design task.

  4. A 90-minute panel: you'll walk us through your task, then meet people from across the company.

  5. A final conversation with our CTO.

Read more

  • Everyone Ships Code Now

  • 🏢 Equity options in a fast-growing startup

  • 🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 📚 £1,000 personal development budget and learning opportunities

  • 🏥 Company pension, healthcare, eye care and enhanced parental leave

  • 🍔 Free lunch on Wednesdays, and a Deliveroo budget for late nights

  • 🚲 Cycle-to-work scheme

  • 🎉 Regular team off-sites, shared lunches and social events

  • 🧑‍💻 We believe in flexibility, but we're big on working together in person. This role is based in our London office, several days a week.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Electric Propulsion Test Engineer
description:

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and someone has to prove that our AURA RF gridded ion thruster does its job.

As Electric Propulsion Test Engineer, you run the test programme that turns designs into verified, flight-ready hardware, using NewOrbit's own vacuum facilities.

You work shoulder to shoulder with our propulsion engineers. You build the rigs, run the campaigns, find what fails and give the evidence that drives the next design.

Responsibilities

Plan and build

  • Plan and own the propulsion test campaigns that support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries.

  • Design and implement test rigs and equipment for propulsion testing.

  • Assemble and maintain test hardware, electronics and vacuum facilities.

Test and analyse

  • Operate the vacuum system, RF generators, high-voltage supplies, gas feed and thrust balance during electric propulsion tests.

  • Run plasma diagnostics and data acquisition, then analyse the results.

  • Feed findings back to the design team quickly so each iteration improves on the last.

Verify and document

  • Keep clear records of every test configuration and result, giving traceable evidence for system verification and qualification.

  • Work with mechanical, electrical and control engineers to integrate and test each new iteration of the ion propulsion system.

Requirements

Essential

  • Practical electric propulsion testing experience, ideally with RF generators, high-voltage power supplies and thrust balances.

  • Experience with vacuum systems (pumps, gauges, valves), power supplies, fluid management (high-pressure gas tanks, mass flow controllers) and data acquisition systems.

  • Working knowledge of RF gridded ion thrusters and of plasma physics, diagnostics and ionisation processes.

  • A rigorous approach to test planning, data quality and documentation.

  • Willingness to work extended hours on-site.

Nice to have

  • Experience with plasma diagnostics such as Langmuir probes or retarding potential analysers.

  • Scripting for data analysis and test automation (Python or MATLAB).

  • Experience with test rig design or hardware verification for flight programmes.

We are recruiting across propulsion design and test. Apply to whichever role fits you best - strong candidates may be considered for either.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

Every business grows through a CRM and a direct line to its customers. Healthcare, and pharmacy most of all, is the one place that never happened. This is a senior sales hire and it carries real ownership. You will run the full sales cycle for pharmacy accounts across the UK, from first conversation to signed customer, and you will set the standard for how Pharmlogic sells. As we grow, you help shape the team that grows around you, and we all hold each other to a high standard.

 

You report to the CEO and work closely with the founding team. This is a consultative, relationship-led sale into pharmacy owners and groups, won on trust and domain credibility rather than pressure. It suits a full-cycle seller who sources their own pipeline, works without close supervision, and wants to own a function rather than work a list of tasks.

 

Some of the problems you'll be solving

As Pharmacy Partnerships Manager, you'll be:

 

  • Building the engine, not just closing deals: Designing and scaling the sales system that takes Pharmlogic from hundreds of pharmacies to thousands. You own the pipeline and the machine that generates it.

  • Finding the providers ready to grow: Using data intelligently to focus on the pharmacies who stand to gain most from Pharmlogic, independents and multiples alike, and building a repeatable way to reach them at scale.

  • Selling consultatively, winning on trust: Leading discovery and demonstrations with owners, superintendents and group decision-makers, earning the credibility a healthcare sale is won on.

  • Owning the number: Carrying a personal revenue target and running your deals end to end, with the autonomy to close them your way.

  • Setting customers up to win: Owning the handover to onboarding so every pharmacy starts strong and gets full value from day one.

  • Sharpening how we all sell: Bringing the market back into the room, from events, owners and data, so the whole team gets sharper together, from targeting to pitch to product.

 

This could be for you, if

  • You're proven: You've carried a revenue target and hit it, consistently. You're a closer with a track record, not someone who needs the machine built around them first.

  • You can coach, not just sell: You've mentored or led salespeople and you get energy from making others better. As we grow, the team forms around you, and you're the standard they learn from.

  • You are fast. Genuinely fast: You move at a pace most people find hard to keep up with. You reply, follow up, and close while others are still planning. Speed is your edge and you know it.

  • You're fluent with a CRM: You run your pipeline in the tools, not in your head. Clean data, accurate stages, no deal slipping through a crack.

  • You can forecast: You set targets and call your number with confidence, and you're usually right. You bring commercial clarity, not optimism dressed as a pipeline.

  • You thrive on pace and ownership: You have a driver's mindset, urgent and resourceful, and you build repeatable things in a fast-moving company rather than waiting for one to exist.

What you'll get

You'll be joining a fast-growing company and a small, sharp team focused on making community healthcare thrive.

title: Controller
description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

  • You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it

  • Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies

  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor

  • You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger

  • Experience developing a small team or a single direct report

Nice to have

  • Active CPA license

  • Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar

  • Public accounting background, especially audit

  • Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable

  • Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual

  • Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure

  • Digital assets, payments, or regulated financial services exposure

Benefits

Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere! $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment. MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs. Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

Apply Today!

If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you're returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar.

title: Senior Product Manager - Carpool Experience
description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


The role

Carpool Experience covers everything between two members once they have found each other: agreeing on the trip, talking, meeting up, and building trust.

Vision: a carpool experience that feels easy and safe for passengers and drivers, from the first hello to the final goodbye.

Mission: make it simple for members to talk, negotiate, meet up and trust each other.

You own six product areas, used by millions of members every month:

  • Negotiation. Before booking, passengers can ask the driver for a detour, a lower price or another special request, and add a tip. Drivers accept, decline or make a counter-offer. It launched in France in 2025 and went worldwide in 2026. It is still a new product: what it should become, and how far it can go, is yours to figure out.

  • Messaging. The chat between drivers and passengers. Next up: Group Chat, and catching up with market standards.

  • GPS Tracking: both the technical capability as well as features it enables (including sharing ETA on the map, ESC bonus in Spain among others)

  • Post-Carpool ride XP (claims, ratings etc.). How members build trust in each other. This includes AI Ratings Summary, BlaBlaCar's first consumer-facing GenAI feature.

  • Communication Service and contact preferences. The platform that sends every push notification, email, SMS and WhatsApp message across the company, plus the settings members use to choose what they receive.

  • Marketing tools. Braze and deeplinks, used by the CRM and marketing teams.

This is a key scope, and you own its strategy. That comes with high exposure: you present to the Executive Committee every two weeks. You get a direct say in company decisions, and you are expected to bring clear thinking and solid arguments to the table.


Your Responsibilities
  • Set the direction. Build the vision and strategy for your scope, turn it into ambitious OKRs, and get leadership behind them.
  • Own the numbers. Know your business metrics, reliability targets and costs in detail. Review them every month and act on what they tell you, without being asked.
  • Shape the future of Negotiation. Work out where its real value is for members and for BlaBlaCar, decide how it should evolve (new use cases such as negotiation after booking, conversion, usage), and prove the impact on passengers (PAX) and GMV.
  • Ship the next member interactions: Group Chat, live location for both drivers and passengers, and the next version of the Communication Service.
  • Run experiments and rollouts with discipline. Run A/B tests and country-by-country launches with decision rules set in advance, together with Legal, Privacy and country leads.
  • Hold your own with the ExCo. Every two weeks, present progress, decisions and trade-offs to the Executive Committee. Take a clear position, defend it, and change it when the evidence calls for it.
  • Raise the bar of the product team. Share your methods, coach other PMs, and challenge how we work.

    • Your Qualifications

  • You take full ownership of your product's outcomes. You go to the data with a question, spot what changed before anyone flags it, and act on it. You don't wait for direction: you come with a clear proposal, build it with your team and stakeholders, and follow through.

  • You turn many signals into one clear strategy. You combine data, user research, market moves and tech constraints into one view of where the product should go, not a list of projects. You can explain it in two minutes, it holds from one conversation to the next, and you cut complexity to get more done with less.

  • You understand the business, not just the product. You know how BlaBlaCar makes money and where your scope fits in. You can give your key metrics, their current level and what moves them without opening a dashboard. You talk about impact on PAX, GMV and costs as naturally as about features.

  • You have strong opinions and an open mind. You take a clear position without waiting for leadership to take theirs, back it with evidence, and change your view openly when a better argument comes along.

  • You communicate at a leadership level. You have already owned discussions with C-level or ExCo on strategy and trade-offs, and come out with decisions. You adapt your message to each audience and resolve conflicts constructively.

  • You have 5+ years of product management, ideally on consumer apps, including at least one scope you owned end to end over several quarters with measurable business impact.

title: Chief Business Officer (gn) @ Clean Data Centres Venture, France (hybrid)
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio company.

Why we exist

Every frontier model is now gated by two things: megawatts and cooling. Grid queues stretch for years, land is contested, freshwater is political.

Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on Earth, a vast resource the grid can, by definition, never reach.

So we flipped the problem. Instead of bringing power to the load, we bring the load to the power. Our autonomous wind-turbine energy ships chase the wind across the open ocean and convert it on board into what the world needs most: compute first, then e-fuels to decarbonise aviation.

  • 70%+ capacity factor — offshore wind that behaves like baseload

  • ~€50/MWh target cost for firm, low-carbon power

  • Zero grid queue. Zero freshwater. Zero land. And the ocean as the heat sink under every rack.

Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs (with successful exits) and industrial operators. Backed by major international investors. First demonstrator vessel at sea in late 2027.

The role

This is not a sales job. It's a late co-founder seat. You will own Offshore Compute, our first and main commercial engine: strategy, product, pricing, customers and the multi-million-dollar off-take deals that put our first fleet to work.

You already know that power and thermal limits are what will stall AI scaling. You're bold enough to believe infrastructure at sea can get around both, and rigorous enough to prove it to a sceptical buyer.

What you'll do

  • Write the go-to-market from a blank page. Build the global commercial roadmap, from first demonstrator workloads to full fleet monetisation.

  • Land the anchor deals. Negotiate and close off-take agreements, capacity reservations and JVs with neoclouds, AI labs, CSPs and Tier-1 HPC operators.

  • Turn variable power into a feature. Design offers built for wind-backed power profiles: fault-tolerant batch training, asynchronous inference, dynamic pricing, zero-carbon AI clouds.

  • Connect the C-suite to the hull. Translate client requirements (SLA, latency, direct-to-chip liquid cooling) into onboard architecture specs together with our marine engineers.

  • Create a category. Use our advantages — no grid wait, no freshwater, a direct ocean cooling sink, very low carbon intensity — to win premium pricing and long-term commitments, and establish floating compute as a new asset class.

  • Be the face of it. Represent us at the top AI, cloud and infrastructure summits worldwide and make us the reference for next-generation AI energy infrastructure.

You might be the one if

  • You've been in the room where AI capacity gets bought. You've sold, built or run serious infrastructure in the neocloud, AI infra, CSP or hyperscale data center world, and you've closed the kind of deals that move megawatts. We care about what you've shipped, not what your business card said.

  • You know GPU economics inside out. H100 / B200 / GB200 cluster economics, orchestration, workload constraints. And you know the people across the neocloud and AI ecosystem who sign capacity deals.

  • You speak the physics. MW-scale power delivery, PUE, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, thermal budgets. You can explain in one slide why land-based data centers are hitting the grid wall.

  • You've built something from zero. You've scaled a business line, closed complex multi-million infrastructure contracts and thrived with high autonomy and high ambiguity.

  • The ocean pulls at you. You care about climate, and standing on the deck of a floating compute lab during sea trials sounds like the best day of your year.

  • You work in English. Fluent English is required. French is a bonus.

How you operate

  • Owner, not operator. You don't wait for a playbook. You write it.

  • Maths over rhetoric. When a buyer is sceptical about offshore compute, you open the energy and thermal maths.

  • Realistic madness. You have the conviction to break paradigms and the engineering and commercial discipline to deliver.

  • Humble and brave. You stay intellectually humble and still take bold positions, especially where conventional playbooks fail.

  • AI-native. You use modern AI tools for maximum leverage while keeping the domain authority to negotiate directly with C-level executives.

What's in it for you

  • A founding-team seat with executive terms, shaping the company and not just a function

  • A real shot at creating a new asset class at the intersection of AI, energy and the ocean

  • A small, uncompromising team of entrepreneurs and industrial leaders, backed by top-tier capital

  • Flexible hours, a base in Nantes and a mandate that spans the globe

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)
description:
Hey, I'm Adrian. I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash.

Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies—including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN—use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships.

Behind that product is a fascinating search problem: helping customers find the right people across 400M+ creator profiles and billions of media files. We’re combining large-scale data processing, traditional retrieval, vector search, multimodal embeddings, and LLMs to make that possible.

That’s where you come in.

Why we're hiring

Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators.

The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API.

We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system—from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving—and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production.

You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation.

If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog.

What you'll actually own

1. Make creator search meaningfully better.

You’ll improve how customers discover creators across 400M+ profiles and billions of media files. That includes retrieval, filtering, ranking, relevance, speed, and the product decisions that connect them.

2. Turn multimodal data into searchable intelligence.

You’ll build systems that generate and use embeddings from images, video, text, and audio at massive scale—then make those signals useful in a real customer-facing search experience.

3. Ship new search capabilities into production.

You’ll evaluate models and technologies pragmatically, understand tradeoffs around cost, latency, and quality, and move promising approaches from experiment to a reliable production system within weeks rather than quarters.

4. Own the system end to end.

You’ll help shape the problem, gather requirements, design the architecture, write the code, release it, measure the outcome, and improve it. Senior engineers here own results, not just implementation tasks.

What the day-to-day looks like

Here’s what a typical week might include:

  • Monday. A customer search is returning technically relevant but unhelpful results. You inspect the retrieval and ranking stages, identify where intent is being lost, and propose a measurable improvement.
  • Tuesday. Deep-focus time. You build a pipeline to generate multimodal embeddings across a large batch of creator content and test how the new representation affects retrieval quality and cost.
  • Wednesday. You work with Data Insights on a new in-house datapoint. Together, you agree on its definition, coverage, and data-quality requirements, then expose it in Search to give customers more ways to discover creators.
  • Thursday. You test a reranking model on a fixed set of real customer queries. You measure how much it improves relevance against the latency and inference cost it adds, then decide what's ready for production.
  • Friday. You review production metrics, investigate a relevance regression, and share what you learned with the team. The fix may be in the model, the data, the query logic, or the product itself—you follow the evidence.

We keep meetings purposeful and protect time for deep work. You’ll have a short standup, close collaboration when it helps, and plenty of space to design, build, optimise, and launch.

Requirements

What you've done before

  • Built large-scale data or backend products. You have solid experience working with systems where volume, latency, reliability, and cost all matter.
  • Shipped products from concept to production. You’ve owned scoping, architecture, implementation, release, measurement, and iteration—not just one layer of the solution.
  • Designed distributed systems. You can reason clearly about throughput, failure modes, data flow, scalability, and operational tradeoffs.
  • Built LLM-powered or agentic features in production. You understand the practical differences between models and can balance capability against latency and cost.
  • Worked autonomously on ambiguous problems. You know how to gather requirements, ask useful questions, and turn incomplete context into forward motion.
  • Communicated clearly across teams. You can explain technical tradeoffs to engineers and non-engineers, give direct feedback, and collaborate without creating unnecessary process.
  • Worked in a fast-moving product environment. You’re comfortable learning quickly, shipping incrementally, and changing direction when the evidence does.

Bonus points if you’ve worked with multimodal embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, ranking algorithms, model deployment, self-hosted models, or GPU infrastructure. Curiosity about the creator economy helps too, but we’ll get you up to speed.

Our stack

  • AWS and GCP, with Pulumi for infrastructure as code
  • Python, TypeScript, and Node.js
  • PySpark on AWS EMR
  • Airflow
  • Milvus Vector DB through Zilliz
  • Elasticsearch
  • LLM batch APIs
  • Apache Iceberg
  • SageMaker, DynamoDB, S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, ECS, and Aurora
  • Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, and Cursor

The interview process

We move quickly and can complete the process in under a week:

  1. Intro chat
  2. Coding interview
  3. System design interview
  4. Team interview
  5. Culture and alignment conversation with our CEO, Avery Schrader

Benefits

What we offer

  • Fully remote in Europe 🏠 Work from wherever you do your best work, with some overlap with GMT+3.
  • Compensation. Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 100,000€ - 130,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.
  • Flexible hours ⏱ We care about outcomes, not when you log on.
  • Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you’re rested and happy, you do better work. Take what you need.
  • Personal development support 🧠 Courses, books, and conferences are on us when they help you grow.
  • Real ownership 💡 Take difficult search problems from idea to production without layers of unnecessary process.
  • Regular offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

And a little more about us...

Founded in 2018 by a high-school dropout and a Canadian (yes, we’re also shocked it’s going so well), Modash is building a suite of tools that help brands scale partnerships with online content creators.

2,700+ companies like Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN already use Modash to manage and scale their influencer marketing work. And we're just getting started. Over the coming decade, brand investment in creators will continue to boom, and Modash will be at the centre of it all.

Modash is here to stay. We have 8-figures in ARR across two products, a $12M series A investment, and we are default alive. We are building a company that will still be here in 20 years; not rushing towards an exit.

We’re almost 100 people distributed across 20+ countries, operating with a fast, async-first culture. If you join Modash, you’ll be surrounded by people who truly want to be the greatest at their craft. People who make you better. Interesting people too, who have done everything from building solar cars, to hanging out with Metallica and Bon Jovi.

Come join us. Be great, do great things, create great memories, all while making a great impact. Do it.

title: Move to New Zealand - Technical Strategist (Solution Architect)
description:
Work alongside our innovative team based in Auckland, New Zealand! We are seeking talented individuals excited about the opportunity to learn, expand their skillset and support our company.
 
We welcome applications from individuals located internationally looking to relocate to Auckland, New Zealand. This role is based in Auckland and requires in-office attendance (hybrid). 
 
Propellerhead hires exceptional talent from all around the globe and many of our people have relocated to New Zealand to join our team. We've created this website packed full of information about moving to New Zealand to work for Propellerhead, if you're interested in making the move to our wonderful country.
 
Prior to applying, please be aware that the final stage of our recruitment process is an in-person interview in New Zealand (click apply and see our application questions for more details).
 
 

The Role: 

At Propellerhead, the Technical Strategist role focuses on the delivery of resilient software systems that power everything from complex infrastructure to innovative new platforms. This role works alongside our Product Strategists to shape the technical specification and platform direction for a portfolio of client products.

We’re looking for someone who combines architectural insight with a strong hands-on engineering background and a genuinely AI-native way of working. You will have spent the formative part of your career as a software developer and still be confident with understanding the structure of software solutions. You'll have knowledge of emerging trends and you are agentic-first where you reach for AI to rapidly prototype new ideas and judge their value in hours, not weeks, and you are at home with directing an AI-assisted delivery pipeline.

You will lead and guide the design of complex systems, and we'll depend on your extensive experience, judgement and insights to ensure that early delivery and continuous improvement is possible. You’ll be applying and reinforcing Engineering standards for programming, and shape the technical solutions our AI-assisted pipeline builds, in a lean and evolutionary manner. Importantly, you will be responsible for ensuring that client platforms align with our technical strategy. You will work closely with the Chief Technologist and Engineering Principal to apply standards, patterns, and tooling in client contexts, and provide informed input into technical strategy through client platform insights and delivery experience.

Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance.

We offer a culture built on trust, continuous learning, and meaningful impact. You'll join a team that values integrity over ego, and clarity over complexity.

If you're looking to contribute your insight and engineering experience to projects that matter - we would like to hear from you.


Skills & Experience Required:
  • 8+ years of experience with the development of multi-tier and distributed applications. 
  • Agentic-first: very comfortable using AI to rapidly prototype, shape solutions, and direct an AI-assisted delivery pipeline across requirements, testing and code generation. This is central to the role.
  • A confident, credible communicator and presenter in front of senior client stakeholders.
  • Our current technologies include React user interfaces, with services written in C#, so previous experience with both is essential. However we also have Typescript, Java, Go and Rust services, so you will need to show confidence in working with a variety of programming languages.
  • Strong communication skills must be demonstrable, with tangible examples of your skills to bridge technical solutions with business needs and present these concepts to a variety of internal and customer stakeholders. 
  • Hands-on experience with designing solutions on Azure is essential, including active participation in building CI/CD pipelines and instrumenting for operations, is required.
  • Experience with streaming and messaging platforms, such as Kafka or NATS, is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in leading the design of complex software applications, preferably for corporate enterprise, where solutions comprise existing services alongside custom development.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You will represent Propellerhead in front of stakeholders, so a professional, confident presence and the ability to communicate and influence with clarity are essential.
  • We are particularly looking for technical leaders with experience or demonstrable interest in any of the following: digital identity, verifiable credentials, open banking, AI agent authorization, edge or device-based software deployment.

    • Responsibilities:
  • Authoring, reviewing and communicating solution architecture and specifications in collaboration with the Development teams and our core Engineering team.
  • Championing the technical strategy of Propellerhead as our key business differentiator, and aligning design and implementation of the solutions in your portfolio in line with that technical vision.
  • Building trusted relationships with key client decision-makers. You will be responsible for ensuring our teams understand technical requirements and for clearly explaining our solution design to client technologists.
  • You will be the go-to technical person for our client’s solutions, including facilitating any technical pre-requisites for delivery or addressing improvements from operational feedback.
  • Developing strategies to ensure quality measures such as speed-to-value, security, reliability, maintainability, performance and functional fit for purpose.
  • Specifically, you will be facilitating the evolution of our code base from C# to Rust and the ecosystem of tools, practices and services that implies, with AI central to how we handle requirements, testing and code generation.

    • About Propellerhead:

    Propellerhead is a leading software services company that designs, delivers, and maintains large-scale, custom-built digital platforms across a range of technologies. We place emphasis on producing technology which is meaningful, has value, and can make a difference in the world. We foster long lasting and trusting relationships with all our clients. Over our 20+ years in the market we have worked with a diverse range of commercial, non-profit, and government organisations.

    How We Build Software:

    We build software by structuring solutions in a product-centric manner and focusing on continuously delivering measurable outcomes into production. Our work starts from real stakeholder needs and the value they unlock, with an AI-assisted pipeline now generating much of the code.As a result, our digital platforms are a mixture of custom components and external services which produce a powerful and engaging experience when combined.

    Benefits:

    • Be part of an innovative team, with a culture of learning and collaboration.

    • Contribute to interesting, diverse, and commercially minded work for well-respected clients.

    • Opportunity for professional growth and development.

    • Fortnightly knowledge sharing sessions, with lunch.

    • Competitive salary. Employee Share Purchase Scheme offering.

    • This role is Auckland based, regular in-office attendance is required. Work within our beautifully designed office and from home (hybrid working model).

    • Propellerhead is an equal opportunity workplace which is free from discrimination.

     

    Cover Letter:

    *Please note - only applications with a cover letter will be reviewed.

    It's very important to us that you include a cover letter with your application - it's your chance to tell us more about who you are and what you value.

    At Propellerhead, we use AI thoughtfully as part of our delivery practices - considered integration helps us stay at the forefront of technology and create innovative, valuable solutions for our clients.

    In recruitment, however, AI isn’t used to assess skills, experience or suitability for a role. Every application is reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair, engaged and thoughtfully human process.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

Cash flow is the fuel behind every hire we make and every GPU we spin up — and right now, that process runs on scrappy startup instincts more than scalable systems. We're hiring an AR Specialist to change that: someone who can take full ownership of collections, chase down what's owed without losing the relationship, and build the reporting and processes that let Finance actually see around corners. You'll sit at the intersection of Finance, Sales, Operations, and Customer Success, which means your work is never just about invoices — it's about making sure the whole revenue engine runs cleanly as we scale. If you get real satisfaction from replacing chaos with a system that just works, this role was built for you.

Own Accounts Receivable, start to finish

  • Run the full Account Receivable lifecycle — invoicing, payment tracking, account reconciliation

  • Watch aging reports like a hawk and chase down outstanding invoices before they become a problem

  • Keep customer account records clean and resolve billing discrepancies fast

  • Support month-end close for everything AR and cash application related

Drive collections and cash flow

  • Design and execute collection strategies that shrink DSO and speed up cash collections

  • Build real relationships with customer AP teams — the kind that get payment delays resolved with a phone call, not an escalation

  • Know when to escalate high-risk or delinquent accounts, and do it without burning the relationship

  • Spot payment risk early by reading the trends before they become write-offs

Build the systems, not just run them

  • Use collections tools to automate outreach and track performance — this isn't a spreadsheets-forever role

  • Partner with Finance leadership to level up AR processes, reporting, and controls

  • Work with Sales to make sure billing is accurate from the first invoice

  • Help build the scalable AR playbook a high-growth startup actually needs

Report on what matters

  • Put together weekly AR aging and collections reports for leadership

  • Track DSO, collection effectiveness, and overdue balances like they're your own scorecard

  • Support audits and keep documentation clean for compliance

Qualifications/Nice to haves:

  • 3+ years in Accounts Receivable, Billing, or Collections

  • Comfortable in a SaaS, tech, or startup environment

  • Solid grasp of AR processes, collections strategy, and cash application

  • Experience with an ERP/accounting system

  • Strong communicator and negotiator — genuinely fine picking up the phone and calling a customer

  • Organized, detail-obsessed, and good at juggling deadlines when things move fast

  • Hands-on experience with Tesorio or similar AR automation/collections platforms

  • Experience supporting enterprise or B2B customers

  • Familiarity with SaaS billing models, contracts, and revenue operations

  • Comfortable using AI tools to speed up analysis and reporting

  • Track record working cross-functionally with Sales and Operations

title: Technical Project Manager - France
description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.


This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.


What You'll Do

  • Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

  • Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

  • Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

  • Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

  • Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

  • Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.

What You Bring

  • Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

  • Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

  • Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

  • Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

  • A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

  • Native level french speaking.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

  • Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

  • Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

  • Experience working with platform or API products

  • Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

  • Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  • Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  • Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

  • Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

  • Home case and presentation at our Paris office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

title: Propulsion Data & Modeling Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer to contribute to the development, testing, analysis, prediction and refinement of the functional architecture for Nyx Earth Propulsion System Development Models.

In order to derisk and gain confidence on the flight propulsion system, different development models are being built in order to run a multitude of tests spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hot fires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between design and hardware testing for the Nyx spacecraft propulsion system. As such, you will work closely with both the design and testing teams to ensure seamless integration and validation of propulsion subsystems.

You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer.

Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the development of analysis, post processing, and prediction tools that can support testing and design activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Work closely with the pressure and feed system engineers to define the best configuration of the test setups, ensuring a high level of representativeness and testability to conduct all fluid modelling and analyses to verify repeatability of the test rigs with the flight systems and to perform test predictions.

  • Support on the creation of test plans for propulsion subsystems (from a modeling perspective), including data acquisition, analysis, and reporting to ensure the performance of the system can be assessed.

  • Design and develop propulsion analysis and post processing tools, to support testing activities and design maturation

  • Work in close collaboration with the pressure and feed system engineers to ensure the anchoring of the different fluidic models and assess against test data

During testing phase:

  • Provide on-site support during propulsion test campaigns, working closely with the test operator and test conductor.

  • Perform test campaigns, analysing in real-time, through different test parameters and ensure test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing.

  • Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test reports.

  • Update and correlate the fluidic models based on test results.

  • Provide actionable insights to identify key performance indicators and potential critical scenarios

What we would love to see from you:

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline.

  • +3 years of related experience in complex fluid systems, fluidic modeling, data analysis and data post processing.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and combustion principles.

  • Familiarity with test facilities, or storable propulsion systems is an asset

  • Experience in propulsion systems storable or cryogenic fluidic systems is a plus.

  • Proficiency in python for fluid analyses, data post processing and model anchoring.

  • Experience in EcosimPro (or similar software) for the high fidelity analysis of numerical twins.

  • Proficiency in conducting fluid analyses using classical hand calculations

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Strong team player with a proactive mindset.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

  • Nice to have, Ecosim experience

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.
